function: The zoom property specifies the zoom factor for an element. An element can be zoomed in and out.

values.function: Default value. The element is rendered as normal
Specifies the zoom factor in percent. 100% = normal. To zoom in, use values larger than 100%. To zoom out, use values smaller than 100%
Specifies the zoom factor as a number percent. 1.0 = normal. To zoom in, use values larger than 1.0 To zoom out, use values smaller than 1.0
Unsets the zoom factor (goes back to normal)
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
